_status: provisional (unit 1.5). The endpoint and request shape are documented (docs.bankr.bot/wallet-api/swap, read 2026-09-17) and demonstrably work (probe 0.3); the pacing values are chosen against the measurements each note names.
_endpoint_note: Read-only: a quote is a price, not an order. The endpoint answers every malformed body with an identical {"message":"Invalid request body"} and leaks no schema (probe 0.3), so the adapter validates its own request instead of probing shapes.
_credential_note: The read key, Read Only ON, held by the analyst role only. Probe 0.3 quoted with it. The adapter refuses to load any credential that can transact (src/fund/credentials.py). Either auth header works (F0.2.1); X-API-Key is what production clients send.
_pacing_note: Quotes took 0.6-1.1 s (probe 0.3; 574 ms on 2026-09-19 UTC). 150 reads in 4.1 s drew no 429 and no rate-limit header (F0.10.5), so these are a courtesy, not a measured budget.
